task_message:
Case V56: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 151x151x121 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case V56 is complete. 

**Summary:** The lesion was identified as a lobulated, strongly T2-hyperintense soft-tissue mass in the posterolateral popliteal/pericapsular region of the knee, extending inferiorly along the posterior tibia (approx. 2.6 × 5.5 × 4.7 cm, 16.0 mL). It was segmented with an nnInteractive point prompt (one initial point plus three reinforcement points along the lesion on sagittal slices), then verified slice-by-slice in axial, coronal and sagittal planes, including just-past-the-end slices to confirm no residual lesion beyond the mask. The outline follows the bright tumor boundary; the only residual uncertainty is the thin joint-connected tail, where reactive fluid cannot be reliably separated from tumor tissue. Final confidence: medium.
